11. There is also a close shot, which is the same as a free throw, except the distance is 5 meters (6 yd. with slopes) from the basket.

12. If the player scores 9 points, there is a double bogey (bogey has the same meaning as the close shot). If a player misses 4 consecutive shots, they are considered to have a triple bogey. If a player misses 6 consecutive shots, they are considered to have a quadruple bogey.

13. The player gets out of the game if they get a double or triple bogey.

14. There is also a par hole, which has the same meaning as the close shot.
